author: pityandroiduser61

title: Great app
body:
One of the most creative ways for a habit tracker, big props to the team. Very intuitive way and I love that not only are there habits but also dailies and to do lists here as well like an all in one dream app.

 But one thing I would really love is a Apple Watch app for this and also Apple health sync for things like steps and so on. 

But eitherways great app, I would have actually downloaded this app even without the RPG levelling system. As the diversity of different failed planning systems are literally what I have been looking for, plus a gamified system? Count me in
